# Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2003

**Amending Section 11 of Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2001**

## Summary

This ordinance amends Section 11 of [[MO-01-S2001]], which pertains to penalties for violations. The amendment specifies the fines for first and subsequent offenses, increasing the amounts to Two Thousand Pesos (₱2,000.00) and Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (₱2,500.00) respectively, or imprisonment of four (4) to six (6) months, or both, at the discretion of the court. The ordinance takes effect ten (10) days after its approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1:** Section 11 of [[MO-01-S2001]] is amended to state that any person violating the ordinance for the first time shall be fined Two Thousand Pesos (₱2,000.00), and for subsequent offenses, Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (₱2,500.00), or imprisonment of four (4) to six (6) months, or both, at the discretion of the court.
2.  The ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its approval.
